AMENDMENT
to the Loan Agreement dated 23 August 2019 (“Loan Agreement”), by and between
Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“Borrower”) and Zameen Limited (“Lender”)
[Each a “Party” and, collectively, “Parties”]
This Amendment (“Amendment”) to the Loan Agreement, is made and entered into on this
17th day of November 2020 (“Execution Date”), by and between the Parties.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Amendment shall be effective from the Execution Date.

2.

The Parties hereby mutually agree to waive-off the Interest.

3.

The Parties agree to allow a grace period of seventeen (17) months for payment of the
first Installment.

4.

The repayment schedule to the Loan Agreement shall be replaced with the repayment
schedule provided in Annexure A of the Amendment. Therefore, the loan instalments shall
be paid in accordance with the repayment schedule provided in Annexure A of the
Amendment.

5.

This Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Loan Agreement.

6.

All other terms and provisions in the Loan Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the provisions of this Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in
the Loan Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

7.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Loan Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
